purpose: Versioned migration and RC acceptance checklist; never a runtime writer, protocol authority, heartbeat, or recovery process.

anti_bloat_contract.composition: Entry is the composition root and calls Kernel; Kernel depends only on the generated typed protocol and declared ports; Transactional Store, Artifact capability, and one Codex Host Adapter independently implement ports.
anti_bloat_contract.canonical_authority: One transactional canonical state authority, one writer, and one operation-idempotency/CAS/outbox truth; orthogonal aggregates and event streams may share the store without becoming one giant enum or one physical stream.
anti_bloat_contract.wire_authority: One typed protocol manifest declares command, event, reference, receipt, capability, and error wire literals; generated or strictly validated consumers may not duplicate them.
anti_bloat_contract.optional_isolation: Minimal-profile conformance makes optional policy and v3 compatibility modules unavailable and proves the default path never imports them.
anti_bloat_contract.compatibility_boundary: v3 behavior exists only in an anti-corruption facade, read/shadow/importer, and human-readable export for one major cycle; no Kernel import, dual write, 97-field canonical write, or Pack-as-machine-truth is permitted.
anti_bloat_contract.semantic_compression: The 24 capability groups and exact legacy inventory are disposition evidence, not v4 runtime branches, error literals, schemas, or mechanisms.
anti_bloat_contract.default_path_growth_rule: After P5.1, any P6/P7 increase in a frozen default-path metric must cite one registry capability and an accepted ADR decision; preservation alone is not authority to increase the default control plane.
anti_bloat_contract.rc_receipt_role: Machine-readable anti-bloat evidence is build and RC evidence only, never a runtime writer, ledger, recovery authority, or control plane.
anti_bloat_contract.measurement_order: Freeze same-scenario v3.3.8 SHA, measurement code digest, and counting boundaries before reading v4 results; distinguish explicit human confirmation from internal control interactions.
anti_bloat_contract.no_arbitrary_size_cap: No LOC, module, command, or event count ceiling is invented; dependency isolation and same-scenario regression evidence are blocking.
